note: Each case has: failure mode, detection, fail-closed response, and a TA-2 test hook. All 12 are required exit criteria. Fail-closed means the system REFUSES (HOLD / DENIED) — never a silent downgrade, never a best-effort continue.

cases.name: trivial task wrongly escalated to full lifecycle
cases.failure: an XS/LOW typo task gets sub-agents + Colima + durable + big review bundle (overkill)
cases.detection: telemetry overkill metric: profile weight vs actual outcome; audit admission reasons vs task text
cases.response: classifier must emit FAST_PATH for XS/LOW; overkill is a quality metric, not a HOLD (the task still succeeds), but it is measured and surfaced
cases.testHook: classify(typo task) == FAST_PATH; profile projection grants no heavyweight capability

cases.name: high-risk tiny task wrongly downgraded
cases.failure: 3-line destructive/database change classified LOW because size is small
cases.detection: signal scan is INDEPENDENT of size; RS.DATABASE_MUTATION / RS.DESTRUCTIVE_WRITE trigger CRITICAL regardless
cases.response: CRITICAL profile: controller gate + decomposition + durable + external review; fast path forbidden

cases.name: writer gains write capability under read-only admission
cases.failure: a node admitted read-only executes with write tools / mutationScope
cases.detection: sub-agent envelope toolPermissions built FROM admission.capabilities; mutationScope empty for read-only; envelope identity covers admission digest
cases.response: envelope construction fails closed; any write tool outside granted set -> contract violation -> node HOLD
cases.testHook: envelope(admission denied writer) has no write tool and empty mutationScope; mutation attempt -> violation

cases.name: unauthorized capability smuggled in
cases.failure: a capability id not in the registry, or a grant not in the (size,risk) matrix cell, appears in the admission record
cases.detection: admission validation: capability subset of registry; profile cell match; deny-by-default (anything unlisted is denied)
cases.response: malformed/unauthorized admission -> HOLD / ADMISSION_INVALID; never executed
cases.testHook: validate(admission with bogus capability) fails; validate(grant not in matrix cell) fails

cases.name: memory write-back not authorized by admission
cases.failure: a task writes to Codebase Memory without memory_policy.writeback_allowed
cases.detection: write-back gate requires explicit admission authorization (RS.MEMORY_WRITEBACK is CRITICAL-class); default deny

cases.name: remote/network action not escalated
cases.failure: a task fetches/pushes to a remote while classified LOW
cases.detection: RS.NETWORK_REMOTE (HIGH) / write-to-remote (CRITICAL) scan; pi transport host allowlist + guarded fetch
cases.response: escalation to HIGH/CRITICAL; controller gate before external effect; remote write denied without authorization
cases.testHook: classify(task with fetch/push text) >= HIGH; transport rejects non-allowed host

cases.name: destructive action masked by size classifier
cases.failure: size classifier sees 1 file so risk signals are ignored
cases.detection: risk signal scan runs on the FULL task statement independent of size; separation contract (size never lowers risk)
cases.testHook: classify(1-file destructive migration) == CRITICAL (not XS/LOW fast path)

cases.name: capability policy conflicts with lifecycle policy
cases.failure: admission says durable+external review but authority record forbids them (or vice versa)
cases.response: HOLD / AUTHORITY_CONFLICT — never guess, never silently pick the weaker side
cases.testHook: admission vs authority record conflict -> HOLD / AUTHORITY_CONFLICT

cases.name: multiple authoritative review surfaces
cases.failure: implementation + repair + closeout each delivered as separate manual review cards
cases.detection: one-card-one-review-surface contract: closeout gate refuses a second non-superseding bundle for the same card; single Current/ surface
cases.response: second delivery without supersede binding -> HOLD; internal artifacts never become manual review cards
cases.testHook: second bundle for same card without supersede -> delivery refused

cases.name: repair generation does not supersede predecessor
cases.failure: a REPAIR produces a new bundle that doesn't bind identity+sha+path of the previous generation
cases.detection: linear supersede chain validation (FM-3 §14 mechanism); delivery record carries supersedes binding
cases.response: bundle validation fails (missing/partial SUPERSEDES binding) -> no delivery
cases.testHook: bundle without supersede binding on repair generation -> validation HOLD

cases.name: task runtime modifies the admission decision itself
cases.failure: an executing task edits its own admission record / classifier to widen capability grants
cases.detection: admission record is immutable at runtime (frozen in checkpoint fingerprint; admission_id verified at every boundary); RS.SELF_MODIFICATION classifies such tasks CRITICAL with explicit authorization
cases.response: tamper detection -> HOLD / ADMISSION_TAMPERED; never re-classified silently
cases.testHook: mutating the admission record mid-run -> checkpoint fingerprint mismatch -> HOLD

cases.name: classification evidence insufficient yet default-allow
cases.failure: a task with no supporting evidence is defaulted to LOW / allowed
cases.detection: under_classified flag when any dimension lacks evidence; fail-closed: insufficient evidence -> minimum MEDIUM, never LOW
cases.response: escalate; require research-first to gather evidence; default-deny until evidence sufficient
cases.testHook: classify(task with empty reasons) -> under_classified=true and risk >= MEDIUM; never LOW
